description: A Java class that manages GPS location data by interfacing with a database and caching results for efficiency.

classes.name: LocationDataManager
classes.description: Manages GPS location data with caching and database operations.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LocationEntry objects for a specific day, using cache if available.

methods.name: clearPoints
methods.description: Removes location data for a specific day from cache and database.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new LocationEntry point to the database and cache if it is not already present.
